summary: The PR addresses the issue by ensuring that through_fields is made hashable in ManyToManyRel, which resolves the TypeError encountered during model validation.

issues.description: The addition of new test files (reproduce.py and test_edge_cases.py) is not part of the source code change and should be managed separately.
The new test files use a slightly different style for setting up Django compared to the rest of the test suite, which might not follow the exact conventions used in the project.
